## AuditChainIntegrityViewModel

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Wpf.ViewModels.Accounting.AuditChainIntegrityViewModel</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Wpf/ViewModels/Accounting/AuditChainIntegrityViewModel.cs:17](../../../../src/Meridian.Wpf/ViewModels/Accounting/AuditChainIntegrityViewModel.cs#L17).

Desktop parity for the browser&#x27;s Accounting → Configuration audit-chain integrity check (W9-GOV-008 verification tooling). Verification walks every retained chain end to end, so it runs only on demand. Each chain keeps its own answer: a chain this deployment does not keep, or one with nothing chained yet, is not evidence of integrity and a store that could not be read is not evidence of tampering, so an unchecked chain is never rolled into a passing verdict.
